name: Fenix A319 / A320 / A321
notes: Fenix thrust levers are driven by L:A_FC_THROTTLE_LEFT_INPUT / RIGHT_INPUT (0 = full reverse, 1 = idle reverse, 2 = idle, 3 = CLB, 4 = FLX/MCT, 5 = TOGA). Start the replay with the engines running - ENGINE_AUTO_START is ignored by the Fenix. Add more LVars (switches, lights) from Developer Mode > Tools > Behaviors > LocalVariables with the LVar tester. Flight controls are not replayed: the fly-by-wire computers treat a replayed stick input as a roll/pitch-rate demand and, with the aircraft held by the replay, drive ailerons and roll spoilers to full deflection on one side.
